name: orgpulse
description: Smart notifications for organisations: rules instead of calendar entries.

scripts.dev: concurrently --names gateway,auth,rules,scheduler,notification --prefix-colors cyan,green,yellow,magenta,blue "npm run dev -w gateway" "npm run dev -w auth-service" "npm run dev -w rules-service" "npm run dev -w scheduler-service" "npm run dev -w notification-service"
scripts.seed: npm run seed -w auth-service && npm run seed -w rules-service
scripts.seed:demo: npm run seed -w auth-service && npm run seed -w rules-service -- --cleaning-today
scripts.seed:docker: docker compose exec -T auth-service node dist/seed.js && docker compose exec -T rules-service node dist/seed.js --cleaning-today
